recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit in core. issue_request: FHIR-54634 is an Applied/Persuasive Security WG change request for Permission to support activity.location so permissions can be scoped by request Location, including negative/location-specific rules.
initial_application: No core FHIR commit mentioning FHIR-54634 was found. Permission had already been removed from core source and fhir.ini by commit 0e2a8a7f83 before this issue was applied, leaving core with narrative links to the external Data Access Policies IG.
additional_context: Security WG minutes for 2026-03-30 list FHIR-54634 in a block vote approved 7-0-0. The current HL7/data-access-policies source and built IG define Permission.rule.activity.location as 0..1 Reference(Location).
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The requested Permission element belongs to the external Data Access Policies IG rather than the current FHIR core checkout, and that external source already contains Permission.rule.activity.location.
